plan: Reduce QQQI to 20% to lower concentration.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to zero.
Sell all AI/Software leveraged ETFs (METU, MUU, MSFU, PLTU) to zero.
Increase broad index exposure with SPY to 25%.
Add TECS, a strong scanner setup, for potential upside.
This plan prioritizes capital preservation with reduced leverage.
conservative.read: This plan aims for low, steady returns around 1.5% per month. It significantly cuts risk by eliminating leveraged ETFs and reducing concentration. Expect lower volatility and drawdowns.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to balance income and concentration.
Reduce leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to minimal levels.
Trim AI/Software and Semiconductor leveraged ETFs.
Add RTX, a strong scanner setup, for potential upside.
Add ADI, another strong scanner setup, for diversification.
This plan balances growth with risk management, keeping leverage low.
balanced.read: This plan targets around 2.5% monthly return by focusing on risk-first growth. It reduces overall leverage and concentration while adding promising scanner setups. Expect moderate volatility.

plan: Trim QQQI to 25% to maintain some income.
Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL) to 6% each.
Increase AI/Software and Semiconductor leveraged ETFs.
Add ERX, a high R-value scanner setup, for aggressive growth.
Add META, another high R-value scanner setup, for concentration.
This plan maximizes growth potential with higher leverage and concentration.
aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets around 4% monthly return by leaning into leverage and concentration. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and high-scoring scanner setups. Expect higher potential gains but also substantially larger drawdowns and faster losses.

plan: Increase QQQI to 30% for higher income focus.
Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, METU, MUU, MSFU, PLTU) to zero.
Sell high-beta single name CRWD to reduce risk.
Add SPY to 20% for broad market stability.
Add OXY, an income-generating asset, for yield.
This plan prioritizes steady monthly distributions and low drawdowns.
income.read: This plan aims for approximately 1% monthly return through income generation. It shifts focus to income-producing assets like QQQI and OXY, while cutting all leveraged and high-beta positions. Expect very low volatility and reliable, though variable, distributions.
